response.sql: WITH hand_tallies AS (SELECT COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '') AS throwing_hand, COUNT(*) AS tally FROM player_award AS a JOIN player AS p ON p.player_id = a.player_id GROUP BY COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(p.throws), ''), '')), shares AS (SELECT tally, 1.0 * tally / SUM(tally) OVER () AS share FROM hand_tallies), compared AS (SELECT tally, share, AVG(share) OVER () AS average_share FROM shares) SELECT SUM(tally) AS total_tallies, AVG(share) AS average_share, AVG(share - average_share) AS average_excess FROM compared WHERE share > average_share
